notes: Large-source-unit candidate checked: מִלְּפָנֵנוּ fuses מִן, לְ and the construct פָּנֶה into the single *before*, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met and the grouping is genuinely indivisible; the head is the construct noun (rule 23) and the suffix takes its own *us*.
The tripartite clause leaves הוּא unrepresented, the copula joining the predicate adjective חָדָשׁ (rule 20); the finite הָיָה keeps its subject *it* under rule 17.
*long ago* heads on *ago*; *long* was defensible and is recorded as the competing reading (rule 31).
